name: Example: Computing the Probability That a Discrete Random Variable Lies Within a Set of Values
problem:
| $x$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $0.1$ | $0.3$ | $0.1$ | $0.3$ | $0.2$ |

Compute $P\left(X\in \{2,4,6\}\right)$ given that the random variable $X$ has the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table above.
worked_solution:
Using the values in the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\in {2,4,6}) & =P(X=2)+P(X=4)+P(X=6) \\  & =f(2)+f(4)+f(6) \\  & =0.1+0.1+0.2 \\  & =0.4.\end{aligned}
$$
